visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands in a brightly lit indoor terminal area near automated kiosks. She is wearing a black bucket hat and a thick white puffer jacket over a pink hoodie. She smiles warmly at the camera while holding her hands out in an inviting gesture. (2) The scene shifts to an airplane cabin where the woman is seated by a window. She is wearing only the pink hoodie now, looking out at the sky with an excited expression and clutching a white quilted blanket. (3) Back to the cabin interior, she gestures with her palms up and smiles broadly, showing anticipation. (4) A night scene on a city street covered in snow. She is wearing her white puffer jacket again and looks up toward the sky with her arms outstretched as if catching snowflakes. (5) In a daytime snowy park or plaza with modern city buildings in the background, she spins slightly with her arms open, wearing a white backpack. (6) A night scene at a festive Christmas market. A tall illuminated radio tower with a digital clock showing 8:10 stands in the background. She wears a beige scarf and puffer jacket, walking towards the camera while laughing and spinning joyfully amidst the market stalls and lights.
